question: The cold snow forest climate is found largely in the continental region in the Northern Hemisphere between ____ northern latitudes in Europe, Asia, and North America.
solution:
The correct answer is __**40o-70o.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cold snow forest climates in the large international area in the **northern semicircle between north authorizations in Europe, Asia, and North America. wettish international mid-latitude climates have warm to cool summers and cold layoffs.**
 
• The position of these climates is poleward of the C climates.
 
• The normal temperature of the warmest month is **lesser than 10 ° Celsius**, while the coldest month is lower than 3 ° Celsius.
 
• Winters are stern with snowstorms, strong winds, and bitter cold waves from Continental Polar or Arctic air millions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cold snow forest climates are divided into two types:**
